hypothesis: A current-feature local spatial tangent branch improves finite-budget future-feature prediction beyond an unrestricted direct residual head. Learned coefficients use current features and existing posterior z only, never oracle coefficients or target residual.
basis: Central x/y differences on interior14x14 of16x16; border zero. Per-patch2D coefficients .5*tanh(linear(head)); free768D residual retained.
control: Fixed signed channel permutation of both tangent columns preserves each patch2x2 Gram. Same coefficient head and parameter count. This tests alignment rather than arbitrary extra rank2 branch capacity.
reference: Existing prior_residual512/400 seed42 checkpoint; same initial common weights and batch generator. Additional1538 parameters in both new arms.
evaluation: Fixed400 endpoint, dev64 and observed96; all are reused research evaluation. No checkpoint selection. Posterior reconstruction only. One seed feasibility pass; not independent test or end-to-end claim.
adoption: Must improve both existing direct residual and rotated control on fixed endpoint errors. Report all arms; no adoption based on oracle fit or training error. If promising replicate seeds before claim.
theory_limits: Local advection Taylor-inspired basis, not guaranteed DINO equivariance or physical camera compensation. Explicit motion prediction already exists; not novelty by itself.
unit_tests: 3 tests passed: shared initial weights/output equivalence; gradient geometry/border/rotated Gram; nonzero finite coefficient gradient.
